part.text:
I couldn't open Settings. This environment has no way to send taps, and the only route I found didn't work.

- **Tapping:** The Settings entry is the avatar "A" at the top-left of the All chats screen, and there's no gear icon. `simctl` can't send touch input, and no `idb` or `axe` is installed, so I couldn't press it.
- **Deep link:** The app registers the `element://` scheme, so I ran `xcrun simctl openurl … "element://settings"`. It didn't open Settings. The app navigated into the "Weekend Plans" room instead, so the screen is now that chat rather than the chat list.

I didn't try further links or actions, to avoid more unintended changes. To finish, someone with touch input needs to tap the top-left "A" avatar and then choose Settings. The screen is currently inside "Weekend Plans", so the back chevron at the top-left would return to the list first.
